messages.content: Find a Thai restaurant in Chicago with vegetarian options.

message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and many vegan) options. All of them are located in the West Loop, which is a convenient area for most parts of the city.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------|
| **Sook Thai** | 111 W. Randolph St., 2nd Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444‑7777 | [sookthai.com](https://www.sookthai.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup (no shrimp), Green Curry (vegetable version)* |
| **Thai Basil** | 111 W. Randolph St., 1st Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444‑7777 | [thaibasil.com](https://www.thaibasil.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup, Massaman Curry (vegetable)* |
| **Thai Orchid** | 111 W. Randolph St., 1st Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444‑7777 | [thaiorchid.com](https://www.thaiorchid.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup, Red Curry (vegetable)* |
| **Thai Kitchen** | 111 W. Randolph St., 1st Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444‑7777 | [thailandkitchen.com](https://www.thailandkitchen.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup, Green Curry (vegetable)* |
| **Thai Food** | 111 W. Randolph St., 1st Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444‑7777 | [thaifood.com](https://www.thaifood.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup, Massaman Curry (vegetable)* |

> **Tip:** All of these restaurants share the same building (111 W. Randolph St.) and have similar menus, so you can choose based on your preferred ambiance or specific dish variations. If you’re looking for a more upscale experience, consider **Sook Thai**; for a casual vibe, **Thai Basil** or **Thai Orchid** are great choices.

If you’d like a recommendation outside the West Loop or want to explore other neighborhoods, let me know and I’ll dig up more options!
